title: Supported settlement path for an explicitly Refused turn checkpoint (refusal operability gap)
outcome: A retained explicit Refuse result for a turn checkpoint has a supported, contract-backed disposition in TermAl and Engram, so it no longer stays held with no settlement path, and no changed-report or rotated-key fallback is invented.
acceptance: Supported settlement path for an explicitly Refused turn checkpoint (refusal operability gap) is done
